biomes.description_en: Open tropical grassland with scattered trees. East and Southern Africa.
biomes.description_ja: 疎らな木々を含む広大な熱帯草原。東・南アフリカに広がる。

biomes.description_en: Freshwater floodplains, marshes, and river deltas.
biomes.description_ja: 季節性・恒久性の淡水氾濫原、沼沢、河川デルタ。

biomes.description_en: Extremely arid low-rainfall zones. Sahara, Namib, Kalahari, Australian interior.
biomes.description_ja: 極端に降水量の少ない乾燥地帯。サハラ、ナミブ、カラハリ、内陸オーストラリアなど。

biomes.description_en: High-altitude terrain from rocky peaks to alpine slopes and montane forests.
biomes.description_ja: 高地の岩場・草地・雲霧林・高山斜面までを含む。

biomes.description_en: Lowland to mid-altitude evergreen broadleaf forest with multi-layer canopy and high rainfall.
biomes.description_ja: 低地から中高度の常緑広葉樹林。多層の林冠と豊富な降水量が特徴。

biomes.description_en: Cold treeless plain of the polar regions above the tree line.
biomes.description_ja: 極域の樹木限界以北の凍土平原。

rarities.description: In-game rarity: encountered on most easy expeditions. Not an IUCN status.
In-game rarity: iconic species most players will eventually collect.
In-game rarity: prestige tier. Real-world conservation status often but not always critical.
In-game rarity: near-mythical encounter. Handful per player expected in a long play life.

maps.description_en: Wide-open grassland teeming with iconic African wildlife. First place every player starts.
maps.description_ja: 広大な草原に象徴的なアフリカの動物が集う地。すべてのプレイヤーが最初に訪れる場所。

maps.description_en: Endless migration corridor. Larger herds, but rangier terrain than a starter savanna.
maps.description_ja: 果てしない移動経路。群れは大きいが起伏に富み、初心者向けの草原よりやや荒々しい。

maps.description_en: Seasonal wetland maze. Water-adapted species dominate; navigation is slow.
maps.description_ja: 季節性の湿地帯。水辺に適応した動物が主役で、移動は遅く難しい。

maps.description_en: Extreme aridity. Few species, but the ones that live here are specialised and elusive.
maps.description_ja: 極度の乾燥地帯。生息種は少ないが、その一つひとつが特殊化していて捕獲は難しい。

maps.description_en: High-altitude escarpments and Saharan foothills. Cold nights, thin trails.
maps.description_ja: 高地の急峻な断崖とサハラの麓。冷え込む夜、細い道。

maps.description_en: Afromontane moorland and cliff. Home of Gelada, Walia Ibex, and the Ethiopian Wolf.
maps.description_ja: アフロモンタンの荒野と断崖。ゲラダ、ワリアアイベックス、エチオピアオオカミの故郷。

maps.description_en: Volcanic cloud forest straddling the DRC / Rwanda / Uganda border. Mountain Gorilla + Golden Monkey specialist map.
maps.description_ja: コンゴ・ルワンダ・ウガンダの三国国境にまたがる火山性雲霧林。マウンテンゴリラとゴールデンモンキーの専門マップ。

maps.description_en: Alpine climb from lower forest to snow line. Multiple micro-habitats; longer return.
maps.description_ja: 低地の森林から雪線までを登る。多様な小生息域を跨ぐが往復時間は長い。

maps.description_en: Dense equatorial forest. Apes, forest antelopes, and one legendary forest giraffe.
maps.description_ja: 赤道直下の密林。類人猿、森の偶蹄類、そして幻の森のキリンが棲む。

maps.description_en: Not in v0.3 initial roster. Ships when the South America expansion unlocks.
maps.description_ja: v0.3の初期公開範囲には含まれない。南米エクスパンション公開時に開放。

maps.description_en: Not in v0.3. Ships with the Southeast Asia expansion (Sumatran Tiger, Sumatran Orangutan).
maps.description_ja: v0.3非対応。東南アジア・エクスパンションで開放(スマトラトラ、スマトラオランウータン)。

maps.description_en: Not in v0.3. Reserved for the Saola — the 'Asian Unicorn' — when SE Asia unlocks.
maps.description_ja: v0.3非対応。東南アジア公開時、『アジアの一角獣』サオラのために予約されたマップ。

maps.description_en: Not in v0.3. Ships with the Oceania expansion (Red Kangaroo, Dingo, Emu).
maps.description_ja: v0.3非対応。オセアニア・エクスパンションで開放(アカカンガルー、ディンゴ、エミュー)。

maps.description_en: Not in v0.3. Ships with the South Asia expansion (Snow Leopard).
maps.description_ja: v0.3非対応。南アジア・エクスパンションで開放(ユキヒョウ)。

maps.description_en: Not in v0.3. Ships with the Arctic expansion (Polar Bear, Arctic Fox).
maps.description_ja: v0.3非対応。北極エクスパンションで開放(ホッキョクグマ、ホッキョクギツネ)。

animals.description_en: Graceful savanna antelope. Everywhere on the plains.
animals.description_ja: 優雅なサバンナのアンテロープ。平原のどこにでもいる。

animals.description_en: Iconic striped equid of the East African plains.
animals.description_ja: 東アフリカ平原を象徴する縞模様の草食動物。

animals.description_en: The great migrator. Millions cross the Mara every year.
animals.description_ja: 大移動の主役。年に数百万頭がマラ川を渡る。

animals.description_en: Tusked pig of the savanna; runs with its tail up.
animals.description_ja: サバンナに棲む牙のあるイノシシ。尾をピンと立てて走る。

animals.description_en: Heavy, unpredictable herd animal. Feared even by lions.
animals.description_ja: 重量級で予測不能な群れ動物。ライオンさえ恐れる。

animals.placement_note: Southern African species. v0.3: only spawns on Okavango Delta (real range).
animals.description_en: Large ground-dwelling monkey of Southern Africa. Highly social.
animals.description_ja: 南アフリカに棲む大型の地上性ザル。強く群れて社会を成す。

animals.description_en: Small, quick, and inquisitive.
animals.description_ja: 小柄で敏捷、好奇心旺盛。

animals.description_en: South African antelope famous for its vertical pronking.
animals.description_ja: 真上に飛び跳ねる姿で有名な南アフリカのアンテロープ。

animals.description_en: Sentry-standing desert mongoose. Popular with visitors.
animals.description_ja: 立哨する砂漠のマングース。来園者に人気。

animals.description_en: Termite-eating burrower. Rarely seen despite being widespread.
animals.description_ja: シロアリを食べる穴掘り屋。数は多いが姿を見せない。

animals.description_en: Massive semi-aquatic. One of Africa's deadliest animals.
animals.description_ja: 半水生の巨体。アフリカで最も危険な動物のひとつ。

animals.description_en: Ambush predator of every African river.
animals.description_ja: アフリカの河川すべてに潜む待ち伏せ捕食者。

animals.description_en: Tiny desert fox with huge ears. Sahara and Sahel margin.
animals.description_ja: 巨大な耳を持つ小さな砂漠のキツネ。サハラとサヘルの縁に生息。

animals.placement_note: Requires Australian Outback map (future_expansion Oceania).
animals.description_en: Australia's wild dog. Long-legged and wary.
animals.description_ja: オーストラリアの野犬。脚が長く用心深い。

animals.placement_note: v0.3 addition: correct baboon species for East Africa (Kenya, Tanzania, Ethiopia). Replaces v0.2 Chacma proxy rows.
animals.description_en: Widespread East African baboon. Large, social, and adaptable.
animals.description_ja: 東アフリカに広く分布するヒヒ。大型で社会性が高く、環境適応力が高い。

animals.description_en: Tallest land animal. Every visitor wants a photo.
animals.description_ja: 陸上最高身長の動物。来園者は必ず撮影する。

animals.description_en: Largest land animal. Slow to age up but hugely valuable.
animals.description_ja: 陸上最大の動物。成長は遅いが極めて価値が高い。

animals.description_en: Solitary big cat that adapts to nearly every African biome.
animals.description_ja: アフリカのほぼ全バイオームに適応する単独行動の大型ネコ科。

animals.description_en: Fastest land animal. Fragile compared to other big cats.
animals.description_ja: 陸上最速の動物。他の大型ネコ科より繊細。

animals.description_en: Highly social carnivore. Clan-based societies.
animals.description_ja: 高度に社会的な捕食者。氏族制の群れをつくる。

animals.description_en: Endangered pack hunter with the highest hunting success rate on the continent.
animals.description_ja: 絶滅危惧。大陸屈指の狩猟成功率を誇る群れハンター。

animals.description_en: Long-legged small cat. Leaps to catch birds.
animals.description_ja: 脚の長い小型ネコ科。跳躍して鳥を捕える。

animals.description_en: Tufted-eared cat of arid and mountainous zones — real range includes North Africa.
animals.description_ja: 房耳のネコ科。乾燥地帯と山岳。実生息域は北アフリカを含む。

animals.placement_note: Requires Australian Outback map (future_expansion Oceania).
animals.description_en: World's largest marsupial. Australia only.
animals.description_ja: 世界最大の有袋類。オーストラリアのみ。

animals.description_en: Endangered highland canid endemic to Ethiopia. Only ~500 left.
animals.description_ja: エチオピア高原固有の絶滅危惧のイヌ科。生息数は約500頭。

animals.description_en: Only macaque native to Africa. Atlas cedar forests.
animals.description_ja: アフリカ産唯一のマカク。アトラス山脈のシダー林に棲む。

animals.placement_note: Requires Australian Outback map (future_expansion Oceania).
animals.description_en: Second-tallest living bird. Curious and fast.
animals.description_ja: 現生では二番目に背の高い鳥。好奇心旺盛で走るのが速い。

animals.description_en: Insect-eating fox with cartoon-large ears.
animals.description_ja: 漫画のような大きな耳を持つ、昆虫を食べるキツネ。

animals.description_en: Massive African scavenger. 3.5-metre wingspan.
animals.description_ja: 巨大なアフリカのスカベンジャー。翼開長3.5m。

animals.placement_note: v0.3 addition: Ethiopian Highlands endemic. Grazing 'bleeding-heart' primate found nowhere else.
animals.description_en: Ethiopian Highlands endemic. World's only grass-eating primate. Bare red chest patch gives it the 'bleeding-heart' nickname.
animals.description_ja: エチオピア高原固有種。世界で唯一草を主食とする霊長類。胸の赤い斑から『ブリーディングハート』とも。

animals.description_en: Only truly social big cat. Icon of the savanna.
animals.description_ja: 真に社会性を持つ唯一の大型ネコ科。サバンナの象徴。

animals.description_en: Critically endangered. Pointed prehensile lip for browsing.
animals.description_ja: 絶滅寸前。伸縮する尖った上唇で葉を食む。

animals.description_en: Closest living relative to humans. Tool-users.
animals.description_ja: ヒトに最も近い現生種のひとつ。道具を使う。

animals.description_en: Virunga cloud-forest gorilla. Around 1,000 left in the wild.
animals.description_ja: ヴィルンガ雲霧林のゴリラ。野生では約1,000頭のみ。

animals.description_en: Striped forest antelope of the Congo basin. Almost never seen in the wild.
animals.description_ja: コンゴ盆地の縞模様の森林アンテロープ。野生でその姿はほぼ見られない。

animals.placement_note: Requires Amazon Rainforest map (future_expansion South America).
animals.description_en: Third-largest big cat and Amazon apex predator.
animals.description_ja: 3番目に大きな大型ネコ科。アマゾンの頂点捕食者。

animals.placement_note: Requires Amazon Rainforest map (future_expansion South America).
animals.description_en: 2-metre insect specialist. Distinctive coat pattern.
animals.description_ja: 全長2mの昆虫食スペシャリスト。特徴的な体色。

animals.placement_note: Requires Himalayan Foothills map (future_expansion South Asia).
animals.description_en: Ghost of the mountains. Legendary elusiveness in real life.
animals.description_ja: 山の亡霊。実生活でも伝説的なほど姿を見せない。

animals.placement_note: No matching map in v0.3. Real range = Sichuan bamboo forests. Requires a future East Asia map.
animals.description_en: Bamboo-eating bear. Highest visitor draw at Rare tier.
animals.description_ja: 竹を食べるクマ科。レア帯で最大級の集客力。

animals.placement_note: No matching map in v0.3. Real range = Indian subcontinent lowlands. Requires a future Indian Subcontinent map.
animals.description_en: Largest wild cat. Solitary and powerful.
animals.description_ja: 現生最大の野生ネコ科。単独行動で強靭。

animals.placement_note: v0.3 addition: Simien Mountains endemic. Critically endangered — around 500 individuals in reality.
animals.description_en: Endemic wild goat of Ethiopia's Simien Mountains. Around 500 individuals — critically endangered.
animals.description_ja: エチオピア・シミエン山地固有の野生ヤギ。実生息数は約500頭で絶滅危惧。

animals.placement_note: v0.3 addition: Virunga Massif endemic. Bamboo-forest specialist.
animals.description_en: Endangered guenon endemic to the Virunga volcanoes bamboo forest. Vivid gold flanks give it its name.
animals.description_ja: ヴィルンガ火山群の竹林に固有の絶滅危惧のオナガザル科。鮮やかな金色の脇腹から命名。

animals.placement_note: Removed from normal spawn. Reserved for future Conservation / Special Event surface.
animals.description_en: Functionally extinct in the wild (2 individuals remain). Reserved for a future event.
animals.description_ja: 野生では事実上絶滅(現存2頭)。将来イベント用に予約。

animals.description_en: Peaceful great ape. Only south of the Congo River.
animals.description_ja: 穏やかな大型類人猿。コンゴ川の南側にのみ生息。

animals.placement_note: Requires Sumatran Rainforest map (future_expansion Southeast Asia).
animals.description_en: Smallest tiger subspecies, less than 400 left.
animals.description_ja: 最も小型のトラ亜種。400頭未満しか残っていない。

animals.name_ja: スマトラオランウータン
animals.placement_note: Requires Sumatran Rainforest map (future_expansion Southeast Asia).
animals.description_en: Red ape of the canopy. Critically endangered.
animals.description_ja: 樹冠に棲む赤い類人猿。近絶滅種。

animals.placement_note: Requires Arctic Tundra map (future_expansion Arctic).
animals.description_en: Ice-dependent apex predator.
animals.description_ja: 氷に依存する頂点捕食者。

animals.placement_note: Requires Arctic Tundra map (future_expansion Arctic).
animals.description_en: White in winter, brown in summer. Champion of insulation.
animals.description_ja: 冬は白、夏は茶。断熱性能の王者。

animals.placement_note: No matching map in v0.3. Real range = Russian Far East / NE China. Requires a future Amur / Manchurian map.
animals.description_en: Cold-adapted leopard. Fewer than 120 individuals globally.
animals.description_ja: 寒冷地適応のヒョウ亜種。世界に120頭未満。

animals.placement_note: Requires Annamite Range map (future_expansion Southeast Asia).
animals.description_en: The 'Asian Unicorn'. Almost mythical Vietnamese bovid.
animals.description_ja: 『アジアの一角獣』。ほぼ神話的なベトナムのウシ科動物。

animals.placement_note: No matching map in v0.3. Real range = Ujung Kulon NP, Java. Requires a future Javan Rainforest map.
animals.description_en: Around 76 individuals total.
animals.description_ja: 現存総数約76頭。

animals.placement_note: No matching map in v0.3. Real range = predator-free islands off New Zealand. Requires a future New Zealand map.
animals.description_en: Flightless nocturnal parrot.
animals.description_ja: 飛べない夜行性のオウム。

animals.description_en: Congo's forest giraffe. Ituri Forest, DRC.
animals.description_ja: コンゴの森のキリン。DRC・イトゥリ森林。

animals.placement_note: No matching map in v0.3. Real range = Cameroon-Nigeria border. Requires a future West African Rainforest map.
animals.description_en: Rarest great ape. Fewer than 300 individuals.
animals.description_ja: 最も希少な類人猿。300頭未満。

hunters.name: Amara Koné
hunters.personality: Cheerful new recruit from the coastal towns.
hunters.description: Reliable first Hunter for any player. Cheap, competent, no surprises.

hunters.name: Kofi Mensah
hunters.personality: Grew up on the edge of the Congo. Quiet but sure-footed.
hunters.description: Second-cheapest Hunter. Slight edge in forest biomes.

hunters.name: Hana Ito
hunters.personality: Level-headed rookie from an old expedition family.
hunters.description: Slightly stronger than the other rookies; often the second Hunter a player unlocks.

hunters.name: Zara Okafor
hunters.personality: Patient tracker. Would rather come back empty-handed than settle for a common find.
hunters.description: Boosts the odds of returning with a Rare or better, at the cost of speed.

hunters.name: Diego Ramírez
hunters.personality: Amazon-born biologist. Reads the canopy like a book.
hunters.description: Rare-find specialist tuned for rainforest maps.

hunters.name: Nadia Kowalski
hunters.name_ja: ナディア・コワルスキ
hunters.personality: Alpine specialist. Speaks softly, climbs faster than anyone.
hunters.description: Substantially better on mountain maps; average elsewhere.

hunters.name: Nima Kirat
hunters.personality: Legendary high-altitude guide. The only Hunter fluent above 6000m.
hunters.description: Only Hunter who reliably returns from extreme mountain expeditions.

hunters.name: Sky Winterhawk
hunters.name_ja: スカイ・ウィンターホーク
hunters.personality: Trained in the northern boreal. Reads tracks by moonlight.
hunters.description: Nocturnal specialist tuned for cold biomes.

hunters.name: Ravi Menon
hunters.personality: Ex-military tracker. Nothing runs from him twice.
hunters.description: Straight-up better at succeeding on hard maps; no rare-find bias.

hunters.name: Elena Marchetti
hunters.name_ja: エレナ・マルケッティ
hunters.personality: Tracker who works in every biome.
hunters.description: Elite generalist. High cost; near-guaranteed success on high-difficulty maps.

hunters.name: Miguel Santos
hunters.personality: Runs everywhere. Returns before you finish your coffee.
hunters.description: Best-in-slot for cycling many short expeditions per real-world day.

hunters.name: Sara Lindqvist
hunters.name_ja: サラ・リンドクヴィスト
hunters.personality: Skis where others walk. Loves the cold; hates the tropics.
hunters.description: Speed specialist tuned for tundra maps; slight penalty on hot maps (rule TBD).

hunters.name: Priya Kaur
hunters.personality: Grew up on the Delta. Reads water.
hunters.description: Balanced Gold-tier Hunter with wetland edge.

hunters.name: Kwame Boateng
hunters.description: Balanced Gold-tier Hunter with savanna edge.

hunters.name: Aiko Tanabe
hunters.personality: Undefeated in three continents. Books herself.
hunters.description: Elite all-round Hunter. Highest simultaneous bonuses in the game.

hunters.name: Dr. Malik Osei
hunters.personality: Field biologist. Has found the Saola. Once.
hunters.description: Elite rare-find Hunter. Highest rare_find_bonus in the game.

hunters.name: Susumu
hunters.personality: Meticulous scout. Would rather return empty than take an ill-considered risk.
hunters.description: v0.3 addition. Only desert specialist in the Guild. Reliable success on Namib Desert (and any future desert map); ordinary elsewhere.

hunters.name: Yu-to
hunters.personality: Sprints where others plod. Loves the switchback trails.
hunters.description: v0.3 addition. Mountain-speed specialist. Cuts Atlas / Ethiopian / Virunga / Kilimanjaro expedition time noticeably; ordinary elsewhere.

hunter_skills.description: Added to the base capture success rate. Applied on top of Map difficulty. Independent of rare_find_bonus.

Biases the encounter probability toward rarer species drawn from the Map's spawn table. v0.3 direction: independent of capture success — rare_find_bonus should NOT make captures easier. Finalised only when Review.review_030 chooses discovery-first resolution.
Reduces the expedition_minutes for the assigned Map by this percentage. Bounded by ExpeditionRules min/max.
Hunter.preferred_biome_id matching Map.biome_id grants ExpeditionRules biome_affinity_bonus. `any` preferred_biome_id means 'no matching bonus and no mismatch penalty'.

expedition_rules.description: Baseline chance an expedition returns with any capture, before Map difficulty or Hunter skill.
v0.3: single-attempt per expedition. Multi-attempt logic deferred.
DECIDED: no additional G penalty on failure. Only the sunk dispatch + contract G is lost.
DECIDED: Releasing an Animal returns 0 G. Non-G rewards considered later (review_025).
Additive capture bonus when Hunter.preferred_biome_id matches Map.biome_id.
v0.3: no penalty for mismatch. Purely reward the match.
DECIDED: soft. Low-rank Hunter may be dispatched to a Map beyond recommended_hunter_rank — risk is higher, but access is allowed.
v0.3: kept at 1 for compatibility. Review.review_030 asks whether v0.4 should flip to 0 (discovery-first).
Design intent: Maps with expedition_minutes ≤ 30 are 'short session'.
